frontMatter.title: Lá Fhéile Pádraig Sona Daoibh!
frontMatter.summary: Wishing all our members and followers a wonderful St. Patrick’s Day from everyone at Navan Badminton Club.

prev.title: Monday Club Night (Matches Only)
prev.summary: It’s matches only tonight with three fixtures (G2 Mens, G6 Ladies, G7 Mixed). No courts for members. Juvenile Club Night: Girls 6:30pm, Boys 7:30pm.
